note: Derived from OSM footprints + FABDEM; used only for stylised detail geometry.

gate.opening_method: interior footprint vertices bracketing the mapped entrance road
gate.height_status: total height 22.5 m documented (guidebook); form and detail heights measured from photographs

amphitheatre.method: footprint sliced into 0.9 m bands of the FABDEM surface (seats follow the real slope)

library.method: facade = longest footprint edge facing 사색의 광장 (OSM way/585696477); portico recess and colonnade kept inside the OSM footprint

plaza.obelisk_height_source: published guidebook (조명화, 캠퍼스투어008 경희대학교): obelisks 23 m; KHU archives: two obelisks stand in 사색의 광장

theatre.method: stage axis = direction from the theatre footprint towards the OSM pond (natural=water); seat rows rise with the real DTM and never sit below it; outer radius limited by the OSM footprint

peacehall.method: footprint = OSM way/585696506 (D-shaped); arcade facade, inset metal upper storey and clock tower from user-supplied photographs; grand arches on the projecting entrance block; clock tower in the re-entrant notch beside it nearest a drivable road (position confirmed by the user)

artdesign.method: front = side of the footprint's minimum rotated rectangle nearest a parking lot / road (OSM); massing from user-supplied photographs

way/170482640.appearance: white 5-storey slab modelled from 3 photographs: continuous floor bands with recessed windows (4 bays x 2 per floor on the south face), taupe end stair towers, green-glazed ROTC entrance; same facade applied to the unphotographed wings

way/455725718.appearance: photo-based concrete courtyard building with stepped wings, five front levels, projecting window bands, barred ground-floor bays, entrance steps and side ramps, signed canopy and twin clock fins

way/585696507.appearance: photo-based model with rounded window bays, open roof balustrades, a signed entrance canopy, broad stairs, tiered planters and a sheltered side passage

way/474085540.name_en: College of Electronics Information and Applied Science
way/474085540.appearance: photo-based five-storey brick frontage with a broad entrance stair and flared canopy, an open courtyard with a glazed stair tower, and stepped rear roofs

relation/8269760.appearance: photo-based seven-storey dormitory with twin curved glass towers, a signed teal canopy, a pediment above the entrance, and two mapped courtyards

clip.source: OSM campus boundary relation 11246784 buffered by 30 m
